tab_worldbox_suite_desc: Unified controls for giant multi-continent worlds, live conflict radar, diplomacy monitor, and suite tools.
suite_open_hub_description: Open the unified Catppuccin Mocha control center (Hotkey: F5).
suite_war_matrix_description: Toggle the floating war, relations, and jump-to-battle overlay (Hotkey: F4).
suite_battle_radar_description: Toggle pulsing on-map combat markers and live skirmish counters (Hotkey: F3).
suite_world_builder_description: Generate a brand-new pre-stitched multi-continent world with custom biomes and ocean channels (Hotkey: F2).
suite_core_scale_description: Open CoreScale LOD, FPS, and Army Battalion Compression panel (Hotkey: F8).
suite_visual_polish_description: Open atmospheric lighting, vignette, day/night, and photo mode controls (Hotkey: F9).
suite_grand_warfare_description: Open naval combat, supply attrition, and defense pacts controls (Hotkey: F10).
suite_linked_continents_description: Open cross-world ocean expedition portal controls (Hotkey: F11).
suite_era_chronicle_description: Open kingdom eras and automated world chronicle recorder (Hotkey: F7).
suite_apex_factions_description: Open the Warden Sleeping Giant doctrine, Species Awakener, and Feral Pack Domains panel (Hotkey: F12).
suite_world_relics_description: Manage city perimeter walls, narrow sea bridges, and centuries-long decaying mossy ruins (Hotkey: Alt+R).
suite_modern_age_description: Open the opt-in Tier 1-3 modern warfare, governments, trade, and radar panel (Hotkey: Alt+M).
